text:
Tanya B: FYI GatewayX messaged BizDev saying marketplace demo leads in EU are being routed away from them. They want an entitlement rule. Thoughts?

Ethan L: We should distinguish lead origin: marketplace_listings vs partner_referral_uploads. Ownership rules differ.

Priya R: Agreed. Current default: marketplace_listings -> Redwood SDRs own outreach; partner_referral_uploads -> partner-owned initial contact (if they provide timestamped proof).

Tanya B: These are listing demos where user selected GatewayX on the form. So borderline. GatewayX claims introduced.

Jordan (SI Ops): Propose a lightweight policy: 1) If partner_tag present and partner_has_badge = "Premier" then partner gets 24h soft-claim window to respond with proof; 2) otherwise Redwood has 48h to contact.

Ethan L: Ooh badge tiers. We already have Premier vs Verified partners in the marketplace. Good lever.

Priya R: Add ARR-based override: if estimated_account_ARR >= 300k -> always route to Redwood SDR for qualification (to protect contract flow).

Maya Legal: Need to log partner_claim_proof_url and retain artifacts for 12 months. Also check GatewayX MSA: any exclusive intro rights? If so, mark partner as "contract-entitled" in mapping table.

Tanya B: Operational items: Confluence table with fields: partner, partner_tier, claim_window_hours, arr_override_threshold, contract_entitlement_flag, proof_required(boolean), proof_example_url.

Jordan (SI Ops): Also include risk_flags: on_prem_hw, cross_border_data, NDA_required. GatewayX = on_prem_hw + NDA_required for some accounts.

Ethan L: For automation, here's a sample webhook payload we can require partners to send when claiming a lead:
```json
{"lead_id":"<id>", "claimed_by":"gatewayx", "timestamp":"2026-03-20T12:34:56Z", "proof_url":"https://s3.redwood/proofs/123.png", "signature":"<HMAC>"}
```
We should validate an HMAC signed by partner key.

Priya R: Love that. We'll add a small Partner Claims API and require proof + signature. For manual claims, require screenshot + time-of-click.

Maya Legal: If partner uses claims API, append a clause to MSA addendum about pipeline attribution process. I'll draft language.

Jordan (SI Ops): Routing pseudo-code idea: 
- if (lead.origin == "partner_referral_upload") owner = partner if proof exists;
- else if (lead.partner_tag && partner_tier=="Premier") partner_soft_claim_window = 24h;
- else partner_soft_claim_window = 48h;
- if (lead.estimated_ARR >= arr_override_threshold) owner = Redwood_SDR;
- else after window expires owner = partner if proof submitted else Redwood_SDR;
- if (risk_flags present) escalate to #partnerships-triage immediately.

Tanya B: For internal clarity, let's experiment with partner_claim_webhook and have Marketplace write an 'introduced_by' field on lead objects.

Ethan L: We'll also surface a small badge on lead records: "partner_claim_status: pending / accepted / contested" so CS and SDRs can see at-a-glance.

Priya R: I'll build Confluence page and example CSV/JSON export with columns matching the mapping table. Also add a short FAQ for partners: acceptable proof, where to call claims API, SLA expectations.

Maya Legal: I'll queue MSA addendum draft and loop in Partnerships. Expect initial draft EOD Thursday.

Jordan (SI Ops): Action items: Priya - Confluence + sample webhook by Friday; Ethan - implement lead badge + validate HMAC; Tanya - triage channel setup (#partnerships-claims); Maya - draft addendum; I'll update SI Ops playbook with badge+window rules.

ops-bot: Reminder: Partnerships weekly tomorrow 9:30am PT -> https://cal.redwood/partnerships

Tanya B: Thanks — pilot this configuration for 30 days, then we'll measure contested claim rate and time-to-first-contact.

Ethan L: Agreed. I'll also export last 60 days of marketplace leads to see how many had partner_tag=true and how many were claimed.

Priya R: Noted. I'll include example screenshots and a sample signed webhook in the doc.

Maya Legal: Heads-up: if GatewayX insists on enterprise carveouts, we'll ask for a minimum commitment and clear SLAs in addendum.

Tanya B: Closing: Let's treat GatewayX as pilot partner for this flow. If no objections, we proceed. :white_check_mark:
